chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from al-Halbi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not walk in one shoe. I said, 'And why?' He said, 'Because if you are hit by the touch of Satan, it would barely separate from you except what Allah so Desires.'
ai.seo_question: Why should one avoid walking in only one shoe according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the physical act of wearing a single shoe to spiritual vulnerability, suggesting that asymmetry in attire may facilitate the attachment of a demonic influence (mass) to the individual. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of subtle metaphysical connections between bodily states and spiritual protection, emphasizing that such effects persist unless divinely willed otherwise. The advice underscores the importance of mindful daily practices as a means of maintaining spiritual hygiene and warding off minor satanic influences.
